text: In the isolated desert town of Perfection, Nevada, handymen Val McKee and Earl Bassett are about to leave for Bixby when they find a neighbour dead atop an electrical tower and a shepherd's severed head. A rockslide blocks the only road and the phone lines go dead, leaving [the whole town cut off|who_suffers|whole communities]. Then [a giant burrowing worm erupts from the ground|threat|nature turning on us], one of several creatures that [hunt by sensing vibrations in the earth|rules|how it hunts], and the residents scramble onto rooftops and boulders.
